ledger: woman | walking through kitchen into bedroom in dark teal dress | walks through second bedroom doorway back into a mutated kitchen; distorted hand-like artifact appears at left hip at 00:08 | turns right into bedroom at 00:03, turns left into second doorway at 00:07

kitchen and hallway | microwave on right counter, wooden cabinets above left stove, blue-flower art on right wall outside hallway | microwave mounted above left stove, back hallway replaced by closer wall with door and small frame | reappears in altered form through bedroom doorway at 00:07-00:09

framed blue-flower artwork | hanging on kitchen wall to the right of the hallway opening at 00:00-00:02 | duplicated inside the bedroom to the left of the exit doorway at 00:07 | relocates across rooms

findings.description: After the woman turns 90 degrees right from the kitchen into a bedroom at 00:03, she turns left inside the bedroom and walks toward another doorway that impossibly leads back into a mutated version of the same kitchen and hallway. The framed blue-flower artwork from the kitchen wall (00:02) reappears inside the bedroom to the left of this doorway (00:07), and by 00:09 the kitchen layout has changed—a microwave is now mounted above the stove on the left instead of sitting on the right counter as seen at 00:00, and the back hallway configuration is altered.
As the woman steps through the doorway at 00:08, a distorted, fleshy hand-like appendage or garbled object briefly materializes and morphs along her left hip.
